answer: Admission auctions block fake identities. At the dawn of each epoch, 200 slots open; each agent bids with a ferrous-hard bond of 500 POA. The top 200 bids win, losers are refunded minus 10 POA, and winners stay bonded until the summit of the epoch, when honest work refunds them. An attacker wanting 100 fake identities pays 100 x 500 = 50,000 POA, more than those identities could earn in one epoch. An honest agent pays once and earns witness fees.
